mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 270.0 (index) indicates elevated inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to accelerate monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 270.0), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 1600 and RSAFS > 600000 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market, indicated by UNRATE below 4.5%, signals potential wage inflation and imminent monetary tightening, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO above 100.0) reflects robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 100.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1600.0 (thousands of units) indicate strong residential construction, which signals a resilient economy and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1600.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, the Federal Reserve is in a monetary tightening cycle, which increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in job growth (PAYEMS above 147000.0) and low unemployment (UNRATE below 5.0%) indicates a tight labor market with strong economic momentum, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS > 147000 and UNRATE < 5.0% fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
